title: •••Elite Squadron Stormtrooper
caption: •••Elite Squadron Stormtrooper (V)
game_text: Clone. Heroic. Deploys -1 if a Dark Jedi at Senate. Power +2 if with Order 66. Jedi here are Heroic. Permanent weapon is blaster rifle (may target a character or vehicle for free; draw destiny; target hit if destiny > defense value).
lore: Commander Igar selected the Empire’s most dedicated stormtroopers to guard Endor for the Emperor. All they know is killing and white uniforms.

notes: Group: Imperial Senate (DARK SIDE). Restricted (•••). Bottom-half slip. Stats POWER 3 / ABILITY 2 / ARMOR 4 (value box); deploy 3 / forfeit 3 (printed POWER 1 / ABILITY 2 / empty third box, deploy 2 / forfeit 3). '>' as printed. Icon column top to bottom: warrior (blue, blaster), permanent weapon (black box with green blade), the black EPISODE I icon (column icon, above the VS16 set sphere) → icons ['warrior','permanent-weapon','episode1']; the printed Endor card has warrior only and no Episode I icon. Affiliation Imperial. No credits. Lore matches the wiki; curly apostrophe in Empire’s assumed (wiki straight; not resolvable on the 350 px scan). Base Endor-D-elitesquadronstormtrooper.gif 350 px only; copyright not legible — Endor 1999 line in the form used for the other Endor cards.
